camel_example: aliyun vpc ModifyRouteEntry --region cn-hangzhou --RouteEntryId 'rte-acfvgfsghfdd0000' --Description EntryDescription --RouteTableId 'vtb-bp1nk7zk65du3pni8z9td' --RouteEntryName EntryName --NewNextHopId 'eni-bp17y37ytsenqyim0000' --DryRun true --NewNextHopType NetworkInterface --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DestinationCidrBlock '192.168.0.0/24'
description_en: Invokes the ModifyRouteEntry operation to modify custom route entry name, description, and route next hop
description_zh: 调用ModifyRouteEntry修改自定义路由条目的名称、描述和路由下一跳
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-route-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --route-entry-name EntryName --route-entry-id rte-acfvgfsghfdd0000 --description EntryDescription --new-next-hop-type NetworkInterface --new-next-hop-id eni-bp17y37ytsenqyim0000 --route-table-id vtb-bp1nk7zk65du3pni8z9td --destination-cidr-block 192.168.0.0/24 --dry-run true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyRouteEntry

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the route entry.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
路由条目所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the route entry.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
路由条目的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: route_entry_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom route entry
parameters.name: route_entry_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the route entry.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
路由条目的描述。

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The new next hop type of the route entry. Valid values:

Instance: ECS instance.

HaVip: high-availability virtual IP address.  

RouterInterface: vRouter interface.

NetworkInterface: elastic network interfaces (ENIs).

VpnGateway: VPN gateway.

IPv6Gateway: IPv6 gateway.

NatGateway: NAT gateway.

Attachment: forward router.

VpcPeer: VPC peering connection.
Ipv4Gateway: IPv4 gateway.
GatewayEndpoint: gateway endpoint.
Ecr: Express Connect Router (ECR).
GatewayLoadBalancerEndpoint: Gateway Load Balancer endpoint (GWLBe).
RouteTargetGroup: route target group
parameters.help_zh:
新路由条目下一跳类型。取值如下：

Instance：ECS实例。

HaVip：高可用虚拟IP。  

RouterInterface：路由器接口。

NetworkInterface：弹性网卡。

VpnGateway：VPN网关。

IPv6Gateway：IPv6网关。

NatGateway：NAT网关。

Attachment：转发路由器。

VpcPeer：VPC对等连接。
Ipv4Gateway：IPv4网关。
GatewayEndpoint：网关终端节点。
Ecr：专线网关。
GatewayLoadBalancerEndpoint：网关型负载均衡终端节点。
RouteTargetGroup：路由目标组
parameters.name: new_next_hop_type

parameters.help_en: The new next hop instance ID of the route entry
parameters.help_zh: 新路由条目下一跳实例ID
parameters.name: new_next_hop_id

parameters.help_en:
The IPv4 CIDR block of the route entry. IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR blocks are supported.
If the RouteEntryId parameter is not specified, the DestinationCidrBlock and RouteTableId parameters are required.
To change the IPv4 CIDR block of a route to a prefix list, you must specify the RouteEntryId parameter. The DestinationCidrBlock parameter does not support prefix list CIDR blocks or prefix list instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
路由条目的目标网段，支持IPv4网段、IPv6网段。
当RouteEntryId参数未输入时，DestinationCidrBlock和RouteTableId参数必填。
当需要修改路由的目标网段为 前缀列表 时，必须传入 RouteEntryId 参数，且 DestinationCidrBlock 参数不支持传入前缀列表网段或前缀列表实例ID
parameters.name: destination_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without modifying the route. The system checks the AccessKey pair, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and the required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): sends a Normal request. If the check succeeds, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the route is modified
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送请求，不会修改路由条目。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并直接修改路由条目
parameters.name: dry_run
